dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The guests are leaving one after another with toys in their hands when a few uninvited visitors stroll into the Alpaca Park...

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: The Fatui who robbed me yesterday! It's you lot... What else do you want from me?!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The one leading the Fatui waves his hands, then hands you a crumpled note. You unfold it. A few shaky lines are written on it...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Sorry, but we cannot speak. Our throats were injured while we were fighting alongside The Captain."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "We'll be heading back to Snezhnaya soon. Just wanna bring home some souvenirs."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Alpacas are great... very peaceful animals. Hope everyone can be like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "We paid already yesterday. We put the money in the bag. Please give us three Alpaca toys. Thanks."

talks.objective: Customize the toys in colors suited for the Fatui $HIDDEN

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: Welcome, honored customer, we've been quite busy today — our goods are all sold out. All that's left are a few unfinished pieces.

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: If you don't mind... could you maybe lend a hand? I just need you to finish coloring the pieces we have left.

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: Could you prepare some toys of the right colors for them? That way, they're sure to be satisfied.
